verdict.rationale: Attio documents a first-party kanban view ('From kanbans to tables, visualize your data'). It also ships a standard Deal object, lists for modelling business processes, and customizable attributes, with reporting on stage conversion and stuck deals that implies stage-based pipelines. However, customizable pipeline stages and drag-and-drop stage updates are never explicitly described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of customizable deal stages, drag-and-drop card movement between stages, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the pipeline board.
